[[File:Chyntuck.png|thumb|Chyntuck]]
'''Chyntuck''' was an [[Onion/Legends|onion]]-like vegetable from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. The native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] cultivated it for use in cooking. At [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] and [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck's]] wedding, it was served in the form of rings. It was considered to be a delicacy. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] deemed it as a "safe" food, fit for [[Human/Legends|Human]] consumption&mdash;as many Wookiee foods were spicy enough to cause damage to a Human's gullet.

==Behind the scenes==
